greeting: Two of Mike's scans fill the day and a Tokyo call closes it, then an early start tomorrow for his surgery in Portland.

needsAttention.title: Mike's surgery prep is due today
needsAttention.detail: His oral surgery is tomorrow morning in Portland. Today is the window to fill prescriptions, stock soft food, and lay in ice packs; the prep checklist in Personal Tasks has been open since Aug 14.

needsAttention.title: Eugenia is holding call times
needsAttention.detail: Her Aug 14 note offered slots including Thursday and is waiting on a reply to lock one in. Worth closing before the windows pass.

needsAttention.title: The IMC research call wants a view
needsAttention.detail: You, Mike and Chie discuss next-stage IMC research tomorrow at nine. Mike's StePs thread and the Sustainalytics note are the reading to arrive with.

flagged.title: Mastercard's policy chief wants to connect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invite from Tucker, Chief Government Affairs and Policy Officer at Mastercard, is waiting on you.

flagged.title: Peter messaged you on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn message from Peter is sitting unopened.

flagged.title: NACD New England reception, Sept 15
flagged.detail: The New England chapter would like an RSVP for their appreciation reception.

inbox.noise: Otherwise: Japanese lessons, job alerts, and travel confirmations for Dubrovnik and the Maine ferry.

recipe.title: Baked Figs
recipe.why: Late-summer figs are at their ripest now, and a slow bake is all they ask.

acts.line: The day opened in a waiting room for Mike's throat ultrasound.
A brain MRI mid-afternoon, then a haircut to round off the errands.
The Jomon call from Tokyo lands at eight, with tomorrow's surgery just beyond it.
